pi._comment_web_search: The built-in ./extensions/web-search.ts is disabled by default. Use pi-web-access (git:github.com/nicobailon/pi-web-access) instead — it is far more capable (multi-provider, curator UI, auto-summary, source check, content fetching). If you do NOT install pi-web-access, add back './extensions/web-search.ts' to the extensions array above for basic search (DuckDuckGo scraping, zero keys).
